mapper.select: SELECT fin.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as prodid, finadd.IS_LAY as isLay, DATE_FORMAT(sale.FIRST_SALE_VDATE,'%Y%m%d') as startdate, DATE_FORMAT(sale.FIRST_SALE_MDATE,'%Y%m%d') as enddate FROM FIN_PRODUCT fin, FIN_PRODUCT_ADD finadd, PRD_SALE_PARAM sale WHERE fin.FINPROD_ID = finadd.FINPROD_ID AND fin.FINPROD_ID = sale.FINPROD_ID AND fin.FINPROD_ID = '${prodId}'
